functions.name: run_strategic_scan
functions.title: Run Strategic Analytics Skip-Trace
functions.description: Searches all connected analytics accounts (Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Sheets, Supabase), auto-detects businesses, fetches metrics from every connected data source, finds performance gaps, and returns AI-generated recommendations. Call when the user asks for a gap analysis, performance audit, or strategic scan.

business_id.description: Optional. Limit the scan to a single business by its ID.

force_refresh.description: If true, re-fetches fresh data even if a recent snapshot exists.

functions.name: list_data_sources
functions.title: List Connected Data Sources
functions.description: Returns all connected data sources (Google Analytics, Search Console, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Supabase, GitHub) and vault-stored API keys so the AI can see what data is available.

functions.name: supabase_query
functions.title: Query Supabase Database
functions.description: Read and write data in your Supabase database. Actions: list_projects (list all projects), get_tables (list tables in a project), read (read rows from a table), write (insert rows into a table). Pass action, project_ref, table, limit, filter, or data as needed.

project_ref.description: Supabase project ref (required for get_tables, read, write)

data.description: Row data to insert (for write action)

functions.name: github_read
functions.title: Read GitHub Repositories
functions.description: List your GitHub repositories, browse directory contents, and read file contents. Actions: list_repos, list_contents (needs owner, repo, optional path), read_file (needs owner, repo, path).

path.description: File or directory path (for list_contents optional, read_file required)

functions.name: drive_list_files
functions.title: List Google Drive Files
functions.description: List files in the user's Google Drive, or read a specific file's content. Pass query to search by name, mime_type to filter, or file_id to read content.

file_id.description: Read a specific file's content by ID

functions.name: run_domain_operations_agent
functions.title: Run Strategic Insights Domain Operations Agent
functions.description: Add or scan one domain through the Strategic Insights lifecycle. The run is recorded in DomainExecution and independently validated into a DomainReceipt before completion.

domain_url.description: Domain or URL to add and scan.

domain_id.description: Existing Domain record ID to scan.

functions.name: reconcile_domain_operations
functions.title: Reconcile Strategic Insights Domains
functions.description: Process a bounded batch of due active domains. Every domain run passes through the independent validator and returns a durable receipt.

max_domains.description: Maximum due domains to process in one bounded cycle (1-10).

functions.name: request_domain_protected_action
functions.title: Request Domain Protected Action
functions.description: Create or reuse a durable pending approval for a protected domain operation. This never performs the external action.

functions.name: list_domain_approvals
functions.title: List Domain Approvals
functions.description: Read pending and historical protected-action approvals and their durable status.

functions.name: decide_domain_approval
functions.title: Decide Domain Approval
functions.description: Record an explicit operator approval or denial for one pending protected action. This records the decision but does not itself perform the external action.

functions.name: execute_domain_protected_action
functions.title: Execute Approved Domain Action
functions.description: Execute exactly one previously approved, unexpired protected action and independently validate the result. Use only after an explicit operator approval has been durably recorded.
